failure.title: Keyboard accessibility test navigated before programme reads settled
failure.note: The exact post-DEF-042 one-worker, zero-retry coach accessibility rerun retained the sole failing keyboard result tree, screenshot, trace, DOM context, HTML report, and last-run result after four tests passed and QA-A11Y-002 failed.
failure.diagnosis: The keyboard journey verified the queue skip link and immediately navigated to a blocked programme while programme-detail reads started by the queue route were still active. Playwright then aborted the two prior-route API requests, and the strict runtime guard correctly rejected those non-RSC request failures even though the keyboard behavior itself completed.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
